chapter: Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and the bungalow
title: Playing with Chris Kelly, the Blues King
summary: About three or four years in Chris Kelly's band, whose members are named and which played mostly blues.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: You said you played with Chris Kelly, how many years was that?
I played with Chris Kelly about three or four years.
Three or four years. Did he have a regular band line up at that time?
Well, yeah the band he had was lined up.

Remember who was playing? Oh yeah, I can tell you. I can tell you. It just comes to my mind. Mealy Barnes was playing clarinet. You had Lawrence Marrera was playing banjo. Eddie Marrera, his brother, Lawrence's brother was playing bass. And Sonny Henry was playing trombone and I was playing drum. That was Chris Kelly's band.
How did Sonny Henry fit in with the band like that?
He played by ear and everything?
Yeah, yeah. He was pretty good. Pretty good.
I have to say that Chris Kelly was, he used to play quite a lot of blues. Is that true? That's it. He played a lot of blues?
Most of the blues. Yeah. Blues. Blues man.
Well, is that all they played?
Well, no. No. They played a different kind of type of blues. But I mean, most of the, he was known as the Blues King.
He was known as the Blues King.
